curation_notice: Concise project-authored bilingual labels, aliases, summaries, and semantic confusion pairs; Codex-assisted and manually reviewed against fixed official OSM Wiki Tag pages.

entries.description_en: An aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility.
entries.description_zh: 机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Airport terminal for this feature: Aerodrome means an aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility, whereas Airport terminal means a passenger building at an airport.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“航空场”误标为“机场航站楼”:“航空场”指机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地;后者指机场内供旅客办理出发、到达和换乘的建筑。

entries.description_en: An obsolete compatibility tag; use aeroway=aerodrome for an airport.
entries.description_zh: 已废弃的兼容标签;机场应使用 aeroway=aerodrome。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Aerodrome for this feature: Airport (legacy tag) means an obsolete compatibility tag; use aeroway=aerodrome for an airport, whereas Aerodrome means an aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“机场(旧标签)”误标为“航空场”:“机场(旧标签)”指已废弃的兼容标签;机场应使用 aeroway=aerodrome;后者指机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地。

entries.description_en: A passenger building at an airport.
entries.description_zh: 机场内供旅客办理出发、到达和换乘的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Aerodrome for this feature: Airport terminal means a passenger building at an airport, whereas Aerodrome means an aerodrome, airport, or airfield facility.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“机场航站楼”误标为“航空场”:“机场航站楼”指机场内供旅客办理出发、到达和换乘的建筑;后者指机场、航空站或供航空器起降的场地。

entries.description_en: A venue focused on serving alcoholic drinks, usually without a full meal service.
entries.description_zh: 以供应酒精饮品为主、通常不提供完整正餐服务的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Pub for this feature: Bar means a venue focused on serving alcoholic drinks, usually without a full meal service, whereas Pub means a venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“酒吧”误标为“酒馆”:“酒吧”指以供应酒精饮品为主、通常不提供完整正餐服务的场所;后者指在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所。

entries.description_en: A designated place for parking bicycles.
entries.description_zh: 专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bicycle rental for this feature: Bicycle parking means a designated place for parking bicycles, whereas Bicycle rental means a place where bicycles can be rented.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“自行车停车处”误标为“自行车租赁点”:“自行车停车处”指专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施;后者指提供自行车租赁服务的地点。

entries.description_en: A place where bicycles can be rented.
entries.description_zh: 提供自行车租赁服务的地点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bicycle parking for this feature: Bicycle rental means a place where bicycles can be rented, whereas Bicycle parking means a designated place for parking bicycles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“自行车租赁点”误标为“自行车停车处”:“自行车租赁点”指提供自行车租赁服务的地点;后者指专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: An outdoor area where beer and food are served at shared tables.
entries.description_zh: 在户外公共桌位供应啤酒和餐食的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Pub for this feature: Beer garden means an outdoor area where beer and food are served at shared tables, whereas Pub means a venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“露天啤酒园”误标为“酒馆”:“露天啤酒园”指在户外公共桌位供应啤酒和餐食的场所;后者指在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所。

entries.description_en: An informal place serving coffee, refreshments, and light meals.
entries.description_zh: 提供咖啡、饮品和简餐的非正式堂食场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Restaurant for this feature: Cafe means an informal place serving coffee, refreshments, and light meals, whereas Restaurant means a place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“咖啡馆”误标为“餐厅”:“咖啡馆”指提供咖啡、饮品和简餐的非正式堂食场所;后者指提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所。

entries.description_en: A facility where electric vehicles can recharge.
entries.description_zh: 供电动车辆补充电能的设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Fuel station for this feature: Vehicle charging station means a facility where electric vehicles can recharge, whereas Fuel station means a facility selling fuel for motor vehicles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“车辆充电站”误标为“加油站”:“车辆充电站”指供电动车辆补充电能的设施;后者指向机动车提供燃油的设施。

entries.description_en: A place showing films to an audience.
entries.description_zh: 面向观众放映电影的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Stadium for this feature: Cinema means a place showing films to an audience, whereas Stadium means a major sports venue with spectator facilities around a field or track.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“电影院”误标为“体育场”:“电影院”指面向观众放映电影的场所;后者指围绕比赛场地或跑道设有观众设施的大型体育场馆。

entries.description_en: A medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
entries.description_zh: 提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Hospital for this feature: Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment, whereas Hospital means a medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“诊所”误标为“医院”:“诊所”指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构;后者指具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: An institution providing further or higher education.
entries.description_zh: 提供继续教育或高等教育的院校。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use University for this feature: College means an institution providing further or higher education, whereas University means an institution providing university-level higher education and research.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“学院”误标为“大学”:“学院”指提供继续教育或高等教育的院校;后者指提供大学层次高等教育与科研的机构。

entries.description_en: A public venue used for local community activities and services.
entries.description_zh: 用于社区活动和公共服务的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Town hall for this feature: Community centre means a public venue used for local community activities and services, whereas Town hall means a building housing local government administration or civic functions.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“社区活动中心”误标为“市政厅”:“社区活动中心”指用于社区活动和公共服务的场所;后者指承载地方政府行政或公共事务功能的建筑。

entries.description_en: A building where courts of law operate.
entries.description_zh: 法院开展审判活动的建筑。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Town hall for this feature: Courthouse means a building where courts of law operate, whereas Town hall means a building housing local government administration or civic functions.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“法院”误标为“市政厅”:“法院”指法院开展审判活动的建筑;后者指承载地方政府行政或公共事务功能的建筑。

entries.description_en: A practice providing dental examination and treatment.
entries.description_zh: 提供牙科检查与治疗的医疗场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Doctors' office for this feature: Dentist means a practice providing dental examination and treatment, whereas Doctors' office means a medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“牙科诊所”误标为“医生诊所”:“牙科诊所”指提供牙科检查与治疗的医疗场所;后者指医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所。

entries.description_en: A medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients.
entries.description_zh: 医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clinic for this feature: Doctors' office means a medical practice where physicians consult and treat patients, whereas Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医生诊所”误标为“诊所”:“医生诊所”指医生为患者提供诊疗服务的门诊场所;后者指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A place where potable water is available.
entries.description_zh: 可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Public toilets for this feature: Drinking water means a place where potable water is available, whereas Public toilets means a publicly accessible toilet facility.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“饮用水点”误标为“公共厕所”:“饮用水点”指可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施;后者指公众可使用的厕所设施。

entries.description_en: A facility offering instruction for driving motor vehicles.
entries.description_zh: 提供机动车驾驶教学的培训场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Training centre for this feature: Driving school means a facility offering instruction for driving motor vehicles, whereas Training centre means a facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“驾驶学校”误标为“培训中心”:“驾驶学校”指提供机动车驾驶教学的培训场所;后者指提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构。

entries.description_en: A place serving prepared food quickly, usually with limited table service.
entries.description_zh: 快速供应预制餐食、通常桌边服务有限的餐饮场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Restaurant for this feature: Fast-food restaurant means a place serving prepared food quickly, usually with limited table service, whereas Restaurant means a place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“快餐店”误标为“餐厅”:“快餐店”指快速供应预制餐食、通常桌边服务有限的餐饮场所;后者指提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所。

entries.description_en: A station housing firefighters and emergency response equipment.
entries.description_zh: 驻有消防人员及应急设备的站点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Police facility for this feature: Fire station means a station housing firefighters and emergency response equipment, whereas Police facility means a facility used by police services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“消防站”误标为“警务设施”:“消防站”指驻有消防人员及应急设备的站点;后者指警察或公安部门开展工作的设施。

entries.description_en: A shared seating area served by multiple food vendors.
entries.description_zh: 由多家餐饮摊位共同服务的集中就餐区。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Fast-food restaurant for this feature: Food court means a shared seating area served by multiple food vendors, whereas Fast-food restaurant means a place serving prepared food quickly, usually with limited table service.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“美食广场”误标为“快餐店”:“美食广场”指由多家餐饮摊位共同服务的集中就餐区;后者指快速供应预制餐食、通常桌边服务有限的餐饮场所。

entries.description_en: A facility selling fuel for motor vehicles.
entries.description_zh: 向机动车提供燃油的设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Vehicle charging station for this feature: Fuel station means a facility selling fuel for motor vehicles, whereas Vehicle charging station means a facility where electric vehicles can recharge.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“加油站”误标为“车辆充电站”:“加油站”指向机动车提供燃油的设施;后者指供电动车辆补充电能的设施。

entries.description_en: A medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment.
entries.description_zh: 具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clinic for this feature: Hospital means a medical institution with facilities for inpatient treatment, whereas Clinic means a medical facility providing outpatient diagnosis or treatment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“医院”误标为“诊所”:“医院”指具备住院治疗能力的医疗机构;后者指提供门诊诊断或治疗的医疗机构。

entries.description_en: A place primarily selling ice cream or gelato for immediate consumption.
entries.description_zh: 以销售即食冰淇淋或意式冰淇淋为主的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Confectionery shop for this feature: Ice-cream shop means a place primarily selling ice cream or gelato for immediate consumption, whereas Confectionery shop means a shop selling sweets, candy, and confectionery.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“冰淇淋店”误标为“糖果店”:“冰淇淋店”指以销售即食冰淇淋或意式冰淇淋为主的店铺;后者指销售糖果及甜食制品的店铺。

entries.description_en: An educational facility for young children before compulsory schooling.
entries.description_zh: 为义务教育前幼儿提供教育与照护的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use School for this feature: Kindergarten means an educational facility for young children before compulsory schooling, whereas School means an institution providing primary or secondary education.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“幼儿园”误标为“学校”:“幼儿园”指为义务教育前幼儿提供教育与照护的机构;后者指提供小学或中学阶段教育的机构。

entries.description_en: A school primarily teaching languages.
entries.description_zh: 以语言教学为主的教育机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Training centre for this feature: Language school means a school primarily teaching languages, whereas Training centre means a facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“语言学校”误标为“培训中心”:“语言学校”指以语言教学为主的教育机构;后者指提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构。

entries.description_en: A place where books and other media can be read or borrowed.
entries.description_zh: 提供图书及其他资料阅览或借阅服务的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Community centre for this feature: Library means a place where books and other media can be read or borrowed, whereas Community centre means a public venue used for local community activities and services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“图书馆”误标为“社区活动中心”:“图书馆”指提供图书及其他资料阅览或借阅服务的场所;后者指用于社区活动和公共服务的场所。

entries.description_en: A school primarily teaching music.
entries.description_zh: 以音乐教学为主的教育机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Training centre for this feature: Music school means a school primarily teaching music, whereas Training centre means a facility providing non-school vocational or specialist training.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“音乐学校”误标为“培训中心”:“音乐学校”指以音乐教学为主的教育机构;后者指提供非学校制职业或专业培训的机构。

entries.description_en: A residential facility providing continuous nursing care.
entries.description_zh: 为住户提供持续护理的居住型机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Social facility for this feature: Nursing home means a residential facility providing continuous nursing care, whereas Social facility means a facility providing social care, support, or welfare services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“护理院”误标为“社会服务机构”:“护理院”指为住户提供持续护理的居住型机构;后者指提供社会照护、援助或福利服务的机构。

entries.description_en: A designated facility or area for parking vehicles.
entries.description_zh: 供机动车停放的指定场地或设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bicycle parking for this feature: Parking facility means a designated facility or area for parking vehicles, whereas Bicycle parking means a designated place for parking bicycles.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“停车设施”误标为“自行车停车处”:“停车设施”指供机动车停放的指定场地或设施;后者指专门用于停放自行车的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: A place dispensing prescription medicines and selling health products.
entries.description_zh: 配发处方药并销售健康用品的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Chemist shop for this feature: Pharmacy means a place dispensing prescription medicines and selling health products, whereas Chemist shop means a shop selling health, hygiene, and beauty products without dispensing prescriptions.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“药房”误标为“日化保健品店”:“药房”指配发处方药并销售健康用品的场所;后者指销售健康、卫生和美容用品但不配发处方药的店铺。

entries.description_en: A facility used by police services.
entries.description_zh: 警察或公安部门开展工作的设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Fire station for this feature: Police facility means a facility used by police services, whereas Fire station means a station housing firefighters and emergency response equipment.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“警务设施”误标为“消防站”:“警务设施”指警察或公安部门开展工作的设施;后者指驻有消防人员及应急设备的站点。

entries.description_en: A public branch providing postal services.
entries.description_zh: 提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Government office for this feature: Post office means a public branch providing postal services, whereas Government office means an office used by a government or public administration body.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“邮局”误标为“政府办公室”:“邮局”指提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所;后者指政府或公共行政机构使用的办公场所。

entries.description_en: A venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food.
entries.description_zh: 在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bar for this feature: Pub means a venue serving alcoholic drinks in a social setting, often with food, whereas Bar means a venue focused on serving alcoholic drinks, usually without a full meal service.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“酒馆”误标为“酒吧”:“酒馆”指在社交环境中供应酒精饮品并常提供餐食的场所;后者指以供应酒精饮品为主、通常不提供完整正餐服务的场所。

entries.description_en: A place for depositing recyclable materials.
entries.description_zh: 用于投放或收集可回收材料的地点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Drinking water for this feature: Recycling facility means a place for depositing recyclable materials, whereas Drinking water means a place where potable water is available.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“回收设施”误标为“饮用水点”:“回收设施”指用于投放或收集可回收材料的地点;后者指可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: A place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site.
entries.description_zh: 提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Cafe for this feature: Restaurant means a place serving prepared full meals, usually for consumption on site, whereas Cafe means an informal place serving coffee, refreshments, and light meals.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“餐厅”误标为“咖啡馆”:“餐厅”指提供完整正餐并通常供顾客现场用餐的场所;后者指提供咖啡、饮品和简餐的非正式堂食场所。

entries.description_en: An institution providing primary or secondary education.
entries.description_zh: 提供小学或中学阶段教育的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use School building for this feature: School means an institution providing primary or secondary education, whereas School building means a building constructed or used as part of a school.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“学校”误标为“学校建筑”:“学校”指提供小学或中学阶段教育的机构;后者指作为学校组成部分使用的建筑。

entries.description_en: A facility providing social care, support, or welfare services.
entries.description_zh: 提供社会照护、援助或福利服务的机构。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Nursing home for this feature: Social facility means a facility providing social care, support, or welfare services, whereas Nursing home means a residential facility providing continuous nursing care.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“社会服务机构”误标为“护理院”:“社会服务机构”指提供社会照护、援助或福利服务的机构;后者指为住户提供持续护理的居住型机构。

entries.description_en: A designated place where taxis wait for passengers.
entries.description_zh: 出租车集中等候乘客的指定地点。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bus stop for this feature: Taxi rank means a designated place where taxis wait for passengers, whereas Bus stop means a point where buses stop to pick up or set down passengers.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“出租车候客点”误标为“公交车站”:“出租车候客点”指出租车集中等候乘客的指定地点;后者指公交车辆上下乘客的停靠点。

entries.description_en: A publicly accessible telephone facility.
entries.description_zh: 公众可使用的电话设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Post office for this feature: Public telephone means a publicly accessible telephone facility, whereas Post office means a public branch providing postal services.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公共电话”误标为“邮局”:“公共电话”指公众可使用的电话设施;后者指提供寄递等邮政服务的营业场所。

entries.description_en: A publicly accessible toilet facility.
entries.description_zh: 公众可使用的厕所设施。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Drinking water for this feature: Public toilets means a publicly accessible toilet facility, whereas Drinking water means a place where potable water is available.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“公共厕所”误标为“饮用水点”:“公共厕所”指公众可使用的厕所设施;后者指可获取安全饮用水的地点或设施。

entries.description_en: A building housing local government administration or civic functions.

hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“日化保健品店”误标为“药房”:“日化保健品店”指销售健康、卫生和美容用品但不配发处方药的店铺;后者指配发处方药并销售健康用品的场所。

entries.description_en: A shop selling clothing.
entries.description_zh: 以销售服装为主的零售店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Shoe shop for this feature: Clothing shop means a shop selling clothing, whereas Shoe shop means a shop selling footwear.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“服装店”误标为“鞋店”:“服装店”指以销售服装为主的零售店;后者指以销售鞋类为主的零售店。

entries.description_en: A shop selling sweets, candy, and confectionery.
entries.description_zh: 销售糖果及甜食制品的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Pastry shop for this feature: Confectionery shop means a shop selling sweets, candy, and confectionery, whereas Pastry shop means a shop primarily selling cakes and pastries.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“糖果店”误标为“糕点店”:“糖果店”指销售糖果及甜食制品的店铺;后者指主要销售蛋糕和糕点的店铺。

entries.description_en: A small local shop selling everyday goods and groceries.
entries.description_zh: 销售日常用品和食品的小型社区商店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Supermarket for this feature: Convenience store means a small local shop selling everyday goods and groceries, whereas Supermarket means a large self-service shop selling groceries and everyday goods.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“便利店”误标为“超市”:“便利店”指销售日常用品和食品的小型社区商店;后者指自助销售食品和日常用品的大型商店。

entries.description_en: A shop selling prepared foods, cold cuts, and speciality groceries.
entries.description_zh: 销售熟食、冷切肉及特色食品的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Butcher shop for this feature: Delicatessen means a shop selling prepared foods, cold cuts, and speciality groceries, whereas Butcher shop means a shop selling fresh meat and meat products.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“熟食店”误标为“肉铺”:“熟食店”指销售熟食、冷切肉及特色食品的店铺;后者指销售鲜肉及肉制品的店铺。

entries.description_en: A large shop divided into departments selling many types of goods.
entries.description_zh: 按部门销售多类商品的大型零售商店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Shopping mall for this feature: Department store means a large shop divided into departments selling many types of goods, whereas Shopping mall means a shopping complex containing multiple shops and shared facilities.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“百货商店”误标为“购物中心”:“百货商店”指按部门销售多类商品的大型零售商店;后者指包含多家商店及公共设施的商业综合体。

entries.description_en: A large shop selling home-improvement materials and tools.
entries.description_zh: 销售家装材料和工具的大型店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Hardware shop for this feature: Do-it-yourself shop means a large shop selling home-improvement materials and tools, whereas Hardware shop means a shop selling tools, fasteners, and household hardware.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“家装建材店”误标为“五金店”:“家装建材店”指销售家装材料和工具的大型店铺;后者指销售工具、紧固件及家用五金的店铺。

entries.description_en: A shop selling consumer electronic devices.
entries.description_zh: 销售消费电子设备的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Mobile phone shop for this feature: Electronics shop means a shop selling consumer electronic devices, whereas Mobile phone shop means a shop selling mobile phones and related services or accessories.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“电子产品店”误标为“手机店”:“电子产品店”指销售消费电子设备的店铺;后者指销售手机及相关服务或配件的店铺。

entries.description_en: A shop selling cut flowers and floral arrangements.
entries.description_zh: 销售鲜花及花艺制品的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Garden for this feature: Florist means a shop selling cut flowers and floral arrangements, whereas Garden means a managed area where plants are cultivated or displayed for leisure.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“花店”误标为“花园”:“花店”指销售鲜花及花艺制品的店铺;后者指为休闲而栽培或展示植物的管理区域。

entries.description_en: A shop selling furniture.
entries.description_zh: 以销售家具为主的零售店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Do-it-yourself shop for this feature: Furniture shop means a shop selling furniture, whereas Do-it-yourself shop means a large shop selling home-improvement materials and tools.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“家具店”误标为“家装建材店”:“家具店”指以销售家具为主的零售店;后者指销售家装材料和工具的大型店铺。

entries.description_en: A shop selling tools, fasteners, and household hardware.
entries.description_zh: 销售工具、紧固件及家用五金的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Do-it-yourself shop for this feature: Hardware shop means a shop selling tools, fasteners, and household hardware, whereas Do-it-yourself shop means a large shop selling home-improvement materials and tools.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“五金店”误标为“家装建材店”:“五金店”指销售工具、紧固件及家用五金的店铺;后者指销售家装材料和工具的大型店铺。

entries.description_en: A shopping complex containing multiple shops and shared facilities.
entries.description_zh: 包含多家商店及公共设施的商业综合体。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Department store for this feature: Shopping mall means a shopping complex containing multiple shops and shared facilities, whereas Department store means a large shop divided into departments selling many types of goods.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“购物中心”误标为“百货商店”:“购物中心”指包含多家商店及公共设施的商业综合体;后者指按部门销售多类商品的大型零售商店。

entries.description_en: A shop selling mobile phones and related services or accessories.
entries.description_zh: 销售手机及相关服务或配件的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Electronics shop for this feature: Mobile phone shop means a shop selling mobile phones and related services or accessories, whereas Electronics shop means a shop selling consumer electronic devices.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“手机店”误标为“电子产品店”:“手机店”指销售手机及相关服务或配件的店铺;后者指销售消费电子设备的店铺。

entries.description_en: A shop primarily selling cakes and pastries.
entries.description_zh: 主要销售蛋糕和糕点的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Bakery for this feature: Pastry shop means a shop primarily selling cakes and pastries, whereas Bakery means a shop primarily selling bread and baked goods.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“糕点店”误标为“面包店”:“糕点店”指主要销售蛋糕和糕点的店铺;后者指主要销售面包及烘焙食品的店铺。

entries.description_en: A shop selling fish and other seafood.
entries.description_zh: 销售鱼类及其他水产品的店铺。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Butcher shop for this feature: Seafood shop means a shop selling fish and other seafood, whereas Butcher shop means a shop selling fresh meat and meat products.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“水产店”误标为“肉铺”:“水产店”指销售鱼类及其他水产品的店铺;后者指销售鲜肉及肉制品的店铺。

entries.description_en: A shop selling footwear.
entries.description_zh: 以销售鞋类为主的零售店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Clothing shop for this feature: Shoe shop means a shop selling footwear, whereas Clothing shop means a shop selling clothing.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“鞋店”误标为“服装店”:“鞋店”指以销售鞋类为主的零售店;后者指以销售服装为主的零售店。

entries.description_en: A large self-service shop selling groceries and everyday goods.
entries.description_zh: 自助销售食品和日常用品的大型商店。

hard_negatives.reason_en: Do not use Convenience store for this feature: Supermarket means a large self-service shop selling groceries and everyday goods, whereas Convenience store means a small local shop selling everyday goods and groceries.
hard_negatives.reason_zh: 不要把“超市”误标为“便利店”:“超市”指自助销售食品和日常用品的大型商店;后者指销售日常用品和食品的小型社区商店。
